name: B10-0260/2026 (Verts/ALE) – Repression and execution of protesters, dissidents, political prisoners and religious minorities in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the repression and execution of protesters, dissidents, political prisoners and religious minorities in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Iran to stop killing protesters, release people held for using basic freedoms, and end executions, torture and internet shutdowns. It names two imprisoned women, Nasrin Sotoudeh and Narges Mohammadi, and demands their release and medical care. It also asks the European Union to keep sanctioning those responsible, let international inspectors into prisons, and offer visas to Iranians at risk. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- Iran is urged to halt executions and free detainees; no law changes yet.
- Affects protesters, political prisoners, religious minorities and two named women.
- Next: the text goes to European Union bodies, member states and Iran.
